name: context-health
description: Check whether user-selected Codex tasks still have trustworthy, focused context.

interface.shortDescription: Check selected tasks for context drift.
interface.longDescription: Shows a lightweight project task picker, checks only the tasks the user selects, and displays explainable drift and context-load signals without saving health-result snapshots.
defaultPrompt: 打开当前项目的 Context Health 面板，让我选择要检查的任务。
检查这个项目中已选任务的上下文健康。
